capabilities.name: Identity, Authentication & Access Control
capabilities.description: Multi-method authentication (password, passkey, Google OAuth), session lifecycle management, SCIM 2.0 enterprise user provisioning, and fine-grained 21-resource RBAC permission matrix.

capabilities.name: Project & Team Hierarchy Governance
capabilities.description: Multi-team workspace structure, project lifecycle management, cloning, project preferences, danger zone governance, and email/token invitation workflows.

capabilities.name: Work Item & Workflow Lifecycle Engine
capabilities.description: Comprehensive issue tracking with custom types, dynamic custom fields (text, number, date, select), parent-subtask trees, checklists, worklogs, issue relationships (blocks, relates, duplicates), activity logs, and threaded comments with @mentions.

capabilities.name: Native AI Agent Teammate Orchestration
capabilities.description: Autonomous agents registered as full team members with RBAC permissions, customizable system prompts, multi-model execution via Mastra, reusable skill catalogs, tool whitelisting, and triggering via @mention, assignment, or cron schedules.

capabilities.name: Agile Visualization & Multi-Perspective Views Engine
capabilities.description: Flexible work visualization featuring Kanban boards, Tables, Timelines, and Calendars with two-level grouping, WIP limits, saved filter tabs, time-boxed sprint cycles with auto-rollover, and freeform canvas note boards.

capabilities.name: Hierarchical Knowledge & Revision Engine
capabilities.description: Shared tree-structured Markdown documentation with page locking, ownership transfers, versioned immutable revisions with diff visualization, embedded media attachments, and bi-directional linking to issues and initiatives.

capabilities.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Interface
capabilities.description: Native Model Context Protocol HTTP/SSE server endpoint exposing 100+ project management tools, enabling external AI assistants and IDE extensions to discover, query, create, and update all entities over standardized protocol.

capabilities.name: Multi-Channel Event Notification Dispatcher
capabilities.description: Asynchronous event-driven notification hub routing mentions, assignments, and cycle alerts to in-app notification inboxes, transactional emails (SMTP/Resend), and Telegram bot chats based on per-member matrix preferences.

capabilities.name: External Coding Agent CLI Bridge (@itsaplan/runner)
capabilities.description: Standalone Node/Bun CLI runner (Apache-2.0) that polls task queues from the instance, executes local coding agent CLIs (Claude Code, Antigravity CLI, Codex, Copilot CLI, opencode) in the operator's workspace, and streams token-by-token logs and tool executions back to the web UI.

capabilities.name: Webhooks & Git Forge Automation
capabilities.description: Inbound Git forge integrations (GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo, Bitbucket) for automatic PR-to-issue linking and workflow transitions, and outbound cryptographically signed webhooks with exponential backoff retries and delivery logs.
